value.question: Have food, shelter or migration plans changed? No forced outcome.

entity.mira.goal.value: Keep the ferry operating and her debts private.

entity.orm.goal.value: Protect mountain settlements without provoking a costly war.

entity.pc_ada.goal.value: Player defined; ask before assigning motives.

entity.pc_bram.goal.value: Player defined; ask before assigning motives.

entity.tavi.goal.value: Secure winter grazing rights for several independent halfling clans.

faction.ferry_guild.goal.value: Collect tolls and keep commerce moving.

faction.giant_council.policy.value: Defend settlements; hear trade petitions through local stewards.

faction.halfling_clans.policy.value: Clans decide separately; Tavi cannot command a united army.

item.ferry_seal.description.value: A mundane brass seal used for ferry cargo receipts. It grants no mountain authority.

value.belief: Mira owes the ferry guild twelve silver coins.
Snow has blocked the usual road; no report of another route.

value.speaker: tavi
value.terms: Deliver a grazing petition if Mira finds a willing courier.

value.decision: A ferry receipt is not permission to cross a sovereign border.

value.text: Giants took halfling livestock last week.

secret.mira_debt.value: Mira owes the ferry guild twelve silver coins.
